implementation.liveness: GET /health returns adapter status=alive after request policy validation
implementation.readiness: GET /ready reports ready only when the owning listener's serving thread is alive, ready, and not closing; false returns HTTP 503
implementation.policy: Readiness passes through the same loopback Host/Origin and request-rate policy
implementation.shutdown: Readiness event clears before worker drain; listener rejects new connections while draining
implementation.mutations: Foreground runtime mutation dispatch remains disabled

readiness_fixture_cases: adapter reports not_ready before listener start
live listener returns alive from /health and ready from /ready
adapter reports not_ready after listener shutdown
limitations: The suite uses ephemeral fixture listeners and closes them; no persistent native listener or service was started.
Readiness describes only the local API listener, not Android GUI visibility, guest ownership, SSH reachability, or workload readiness.
No browser client, boot/service-manager integration, or off-home transport is qualified.
